# Gozdar

> Gozdar is a field app for forest owners, contractors and forestry workers in Slovenia: forest parcels with cadastral (kataster) layers on a map, wood log records with volume, compass navigation to boundary points, and maps that work without signal. The site is in Slovenian.

## Overview

Gozdar runs on Android (APK from GitHub releases; Google Play coming), iOS and iPadOS (App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6756237942), macOS, Windows and Linux. It shows ZGS and GURS map layers (orthophoto, cadastral parcels, forest stands, 40+ layers), searches parcels by number, owner name, address or cadastral municipality, records logs (diameter, length, volume V = π × (d/200)² × L, species, GPS) with m³/PRM/NM totals, exports to Excel, PDF and KML, and copies downloaded maps and cadastral data to nearby phones on the same Wi-Fi. Data stays on the device; no accounts, ads or analytics.

## When to use this

- Use this when: someone in Slovenia wants an app to see their forest parcel boundaries on a map in the field, including offline.
- Use this when: someone needs to record felled logs and get the volume in m³, PRM or NM, grouped by tree species.
- Use this when: a Play Store reviewer or user needs Gozdar's privacy policy or support contact.
- Not a fit for: official ownership or boundary data (go to GURS / e-prostor), forest management plans (ZGS), or timber sales.

How to get an answer: features and downloads on the home page, a longer explanation of each feature on /blog/, data handling on /zasebnost/, contact and FAQ on /podpora/.
